articles.headline: AC Milan condemn racist abuse of Mike Maignan after red card vs. Bournemouth
articles.description: AC Milan have condemned what they called "serious and unacceptable racist abuse" directed at goalkeeper Mike Maignan on social media following his red card in Thursday's Europa League loss to Bournemouth.

articles.headline: 'If Mo Salah scores three...' - Hearts boss on puzzle to mark Trabzonspor star
articles.description: Wouter Vrancken hailed auxiliary left-back Rogers Mato for the way he stepped into the breach against Mohamed Salah as injury-hit Hearts produced a spirited display in a 2-0 Conference League defeat away to Trabzonspor.

articles.headline: Rose urges humility after Bournemouth rout Milan as Amorim rues red card
articles.description: Marco Rose said his Bournemouth team will stay humble after they dominated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League while Ruben Amorim said the match was over as a contest for his team after Mike Maignan's red card in the first half.

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Bologna 1, FC Red Bull Salzburg 0. Jens Odgaard (Bologna) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.

Yorbe Vertessen (FC Red Bull Salzburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Bologna 1, FC Red Bull Salzburg 1.
Second Half begins Bologna 1, FC Red Bull Salzburg 1.
Moussa Yeo (FC Red Bull Salzburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bologna 2, FC Red Bull Salzburg 1. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Juan Miranda with a through ball.
Goal! Bologna 3, FC Red Bull Salzburg 1. Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Nadir Zortea with a cross.
Substitution, FC Red Bull Salzburg. Kerim Alajbegovic replaces Soumaïla Diabaté.
Substitution, FC Red Bull Salzburg. Petar Ratkov replaces Moussa Yeo.
Substitution, Bologna. Martin Vitík replaces Torbjørn Heggem.
Substitution, Bologna. Benjamín Domínguez replaces Federico Bernardeschi.
